title: Kissed Cauliflower in Grilled Tunisian Sauce
description: A flavorful and vibrant Chinese-inspired dish made by grilling cauliflower and serving it in a charred Tunisian sauce.

ingredients.name: tunisian spices
ingredients.notes: or a mix of cumin, coriander, and caraway

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Brush the cauliflower with olive oil and season with kissed, charred, and tunisian spices.
Grill the cauliflower for 5-7 minutes, or until slightly charred.
Meanwhile, heat the grill to high heat.
Grill the cauliflower for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until slightly blackened.
Serve the grilled cauliflower in a charred Tunisian sauce.
To make the sauce, combine 1/4 cup of olive oil, 2 cloves of minced garlic, and 1 tsp of tunisian spices in a bowl.
Grill the sauce for 1-2 minutes, or until slightly charred and fragrant.
Toss the grilled cauliflower in the charred Tunisian sauce and serve immediately.
